decisions.reason: As a close-to-core compliance tool that stayed on its own page into 2024 and showed at least some positive agency-oriented feedback, it likely meets modest aspirations and is worth retaining given industry growth and some organizational slack.

Because it is the firm's flagship strategic platform, remained featured on the home page in both years, and directly supports the core hosting business, management would see little reason to search for an alternative.

This managed hosting plan is tightly aligned with the established offer and remained actively marketed through 2024, so in the absence of negative signals it is likely judged satisfactory enough to continue.

Although newer and less prominently evidenced than the other launches, it fits the firm's security and compliance direction and would likely be kept while management gives this core-adjacent extension more time to prove itself.
